notes.title: TGATS UPDATE 1.2 - Graphics, Controllers, Accessibility and more
notes.notes:
Hey there everyone!

Over the years I gathered a list of things I wanted to tweak and improve to make TGATS's overall experience better.

- Graphics upgrade
- Controller support + controller vibration (vibration can be turned on/off in the option menu)
- Improved tutorial
- Accessibility tweaks 
--- OpenDyslexic font (can be turned on/off in the option menu)
--- Black bar appears behind subtitles to help with readability
--- Increased text font size
- Quality of life improvements
- A few bug fixes

Hopefully these changes will make TGATS an even better experience to you!

If anything comes up please send an email to oophok@gmail.com

Stay safe!

notes.title: Zone of Lacryma - New Game on Greenlight
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/O9L2MFG.png[/img]
Zone of Lacryma is a story driven 2D shooter inspired by the old vertical shooters and with a couple of mechanics of its own. Multiple weapons with multiple charge levels make room for lots of different ways to play. A deep and rich story leads you through your missions, giving everything purpose.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/VRvM3Lo.gif[/img]

Help with your vote!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=603662361

notes.title: TGATS UPDATE 1.1 - Steam Achievements!
notes.notes:
Hey there everyone!

TGATS has just been updated with a couple of new stuff.

- A new save system. Big levels will have 3 checkpoints (at the start of the level, at 1/3 and at 2/3 of the level) There is also an icon that appears when the game is saving.
- Upgrade to unity 5. Some extra fancy visual stuff going on.
- Steam Achievements!
- A couple of bug fixes.

If anything comes up please send an email to theguiltandtheshadow@gmail.com
